"People with their minds set on you, you keep completely whole, Steady on their feet, because they keep at it and don't quit. Depend on God and keep at it because in the Lord God you have a sure thing."
‭‭Isaiah‬ ‭26:3 MSG‬‬‬‬‬

The last couple of weeks have been a busy time for me. You are probably experiencing a busy time, too. Perhaps, it seems like it never stops being a busy time. For me, the challenge with being busy, is that I lose focus on God in the crowd of my thoughts on what I have to do next, or where I have to be at what time. Coming to a full stop to spend time with God doesn't seem to fit in the schedule of things to do. In the KJV translation of this verse, the word "stayed" is used for "set on", when talking about our thoughts of God. The old definition of "stayed" is to secure by means of support; to brace up. Consider what it does for you to spend a few minutes with God throughout today. And every day.

-Sean Lennon
